paragraphs: Mevi Yayin: an incident concerning ben Mevi Yayin, whose son assigned pe'ah from vegetables to the poor, and his father came. The explanation is that Mevi Yayin was his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Makom SheNahagu, halakhah 8.
